text:
Chris: Heads-up — noticed a couple of inline images in /kb/runtime previews showing 403. One missing alt text too. anyone own this doc?
Maya: @docs-bot flagged docs/runtime/kv-cache.md as 'orphan-image' in the nightly scan :eyes:
Chris: exact path: docs/runtime/kv-cache.md — image at line ~120 referencing /assets/old/cache-arch.png (returns 403 in staging preview)
Sam: I can take a look later today. probable fix: rehost to CDN and add alt text. works for me?
Maya: if you rehost, please also update frontmatter canonical img path. tiny PR should be 3 lines + alt text.
Sam: quick local check before PR: `sed -n '115,130p' docs/runtime/kv-cache.md` shows the broken link and missing alt attribute
Ava: quick accessibility check — adding descriptive alt text is sufficient here. pinging @eng-infra in case CDN path needs approval.
InfraBot: New issue created: INF-4421 — temporary CDN path approved for rehost (ttl 30d). Assigned to sam.dev.
Sam: thanks. I'll open PR and tag @docs for review. ETA: EOD today.
Maya: if no objections, I'll add you as a transient owner in CODEOWNERS for that file so you can merge the tiny patch.
Chris: :thumbsup: appreciate it.
Sam: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2387 (includes rehosted image + alt text + frontmatter update)
Maya: merged & deployed to staging. Confirmed image loads and alt text shows in the DOM.
Chris: verified staging render and accessibility inspector. All good — closing thread.
